html:
Nha Trang – Da Lat – Mui Ne – Ho Chi Minh City itinerary is one of our signature programs, carefully designed to showcase Vietnam’s diverse landscapes, from coastal beaches and highland retreats to desert dunes and vibrant city life.

Vietlook Travel is a Vietnam based local tour operator specializing in tailor made and packaged tours for international travelers.

Price: USD 450 / pax (based on 2 persons)

DAY 1: ARRIVAL IN NHA TRANG – CITY TOUR

Meals: Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Nha Trang

Upon arrival at Cam Ranh International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by Vietlook Travel’s English-speaking guide and transferred by private vehicle to Nha Trang city. After enjoying lunch at a local restaurant, the journey begins with an introduction to the city’s cultural and historical highlights.

  • Po Nagar Cham Towers: An ancient Cham religious complex dating back to before 781 A.D., showcasing unique architecture and spiritual significance.

  • Long Son Pagoda: A peaceful Buddhist site famous for its giant white Buddha statue and panoramic views over Nha Trang.

  • Nha Trang Cathedral: A French Gothic-style church built during the colonial period, representing the city’s architectural heritage.

After the tour, check in to your hotel and relax.
Dinner will be served at a local restaurant in the evening.
You may explore Nha Trang Night Market on your own before resting overnight.

DAY 2: NHA TRANG – DA LAT (SCENIC DRIVE)

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

After breakfast, depart for Da Lat City by private car. The journey offers scenic views of mountains, forests, and rural landscapes.

Upon arrival in Da Lat, enjoy lunch before starting an afternoon city tour:

  • Van Thanh Flower Village: The largest flower-growing area in Da Lat, well known for its rose cultivation.

  • Crazy House: A uniquely designed architectural attraction, reflecting artistic creativity and fantasy.

  • Domaine de Marie Church: A peaceful hilltop church featuring French colonial architecture and beautiful surroundings.

  • Da Lat Railway Station: The oldest railway station in Vietnam, built in 1932, notable for its distinctive design.

Visit Da Lat Square and enjoy free time for coffee or shopping before checking in at the hotel.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Optional visit to Da Lat Night Market.

Overnight in Da Lat.

DAY 3: DA LAT FULL DAY SIGHTSEEING

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Da Lat

After breakfast, begin a full day exploring Da Lat’s natural beauty and spiritual landmarks:

  • Linh Phuoc Pagoda: A remarkable Buddhist temple decorated entirely with colorful mosaic materials.

  • Hydrangea Flower Farm: Vast flower fields thriving in Da Lat’s cool climate.

  • Stairway to Heaven: A popular viewpoint offering scenic photos of the surrounding landscape.

Lunch at a local restaurant.

In the afternoon:

  • Datanla Waterfall: A beautiful natural site surrounded by pine forest.

  • Robin Hill Cable Car: A scenic ride overlooking Da Lat’s highland scenery.

  • Truc Lam Zen Monastery: A tranquil monastery located near Tuyen Lam Lake.

  • Happy Hills: A peaceful lakeside area ideal for photography.

Dinner at a local restaurant.

Free evening at leisure.

Overnight in Da Lat.

DAY 4: DA LAT – MUI NE | SUNSET TOUR

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner | Overnight: Mui Ne

After breakfast, check out and travel from the Central Highlands to the coastal town of Mui Ne.

Upon arrival, enjoy lunch and check in at the hotel.
In the afternoon, join a sunset tour:

  • Fairy Stream: A gentle walk through shallow water surrounded by colorful sand formations.

  • Mui Ne Fishing Village: Observe the daily life of local fishermen along the coast.

  • Red Sand Dunes: A perfect spot to admire the sunset over the dunes.

Dinner with BBQ seafood at a local restaurant.

Overnight in Mui Ne.

DAY 5: MUI NE – HO CHI MINH CITY | CITY TOUR

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch | Overnight: Ho Chi Minh City

After breakfast, check out and visit:

  • White Sand Dunes: A spectacular desert-like landscape. Optional jeep or quad bike ride available at extra cost.

Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City.
Lunch at a local restaurant, followed by a city tour:

  • Notre Dame Cathedral

  • Central Post Office

  • Tan Dinh (Pink) Church

Check in at the hotel.

Free time for shopping, walking tours, or relaxation.

Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

DAY 6: HO CHI MINH CITY – DEPARTURE

Meals: Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel.

Private transfer to the airport approximately 2.5 hours before departure.

TOUR PRICE: USD 450 / PERSON

Included:

  • Private air-conditioned transportation

  • English-speaking guide throughout the tour

  • 5 lunches and 4 dinners

  • Entrance fees as mentioned

  • 5 nights in 3-star hotels

  • Airport transfers

Not Included:

  • Jeep or quad bike at White Sand Dunes

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses
outline: Day 1: ARRIVAL IN NHA TRANG – CITY TOUR
Day 2: NHA TRANG – DA LAT (SCENIC DRIVE)
Day 3: DA LAT FULL DAY SIGHTSEEING
Day 4: DA LAT – MUI NE | SUNSET TOUR
Day 5: MUI NE – HO CHI MINH CITY | CITY TOUR
Day 6: HO CHI MINH CITY – DEPARTURE
